issues.evidence: Printed Core p221 Share Talent on levels 2/4/6/8/10; repository has ordinary talent_choice on even levels with no share_talent_choice. The even-level class talent choices are not valid replacements.
issues.expected: Odd levels ordinary talent; even levels distinct Share Talent picks.

issues.evidence: Rebellion p41 Contraband appears only at levels 2/4/6/8/10, values 2k to 10k. Production includes comma-split fragments at levels 2-10, including odd levels.
issues.expected: One contraband entry at each printed even level, no fragments or odd-level grants.

issues.evidence: Core p215 Prophet granted at class level 1, currently emitted as class_feature at levels 1-5.
issues.expected: Grant Prophet once at level 1, compute later level effects from progression.

issues.evidence: Core pp209-210 and 221 Command Cover granted once and scales according to class level/context; current pack emits separate grants at 2/4/6/8/10.
issues.expected: One class feature with separate derived scaling, no additive duplicates.

issues.evidence: Force Unleashed pp43-45 table lists Resources at level 1, whereas production emits Resources as independent class_feature at each of 1-10. Descriptive resource allotment may recur by level.
issues.expected: Source-check and model one level-1 grant with level-based resources rather than repeated item grants.

issues.evidence: Force Unleashed p49 Unarmed Stun at 2/6/10 currently stores +1d_, +2d_, +3d_ placeholder labels.
issues.expected: Printed dice values and typed progressions; preserve 2/6/10 unlock cadence.

issues.evidence: Force Unleashed pp51-52 calls first-level feature Piracy; pack calls it Lure of Piracy.
Both class descriptive featNames include Wicked Strike, but their canonical featIds omit existing canonical Wicked Strike feat ID 5bef5e65e532ba7c.
issues.expected: Reconcile printed source eligibility and add canonical ID only where source certified.

issues.evidence: All featIds resolve but parameterized Weapon Proficiency and Weapon Focus are represented by shared IDs, whereas featNames list specific allowed categories. FeatSlotValidator validates ID membership only.
issues.expected: Validate chosen weapon/category specialization against the class bonus-feat list, not only generic feat ID.

issues.evidence: Core Noble Linguist requires INT 13 and Scout Shake It Off requires CON 13 plus trained Endurance. Class grant ledger explicitly evaluates starred conditional feats; no Foundry end-to-end test in this pass.
issues.expected: Test grant/no-grant under both prerequisites in chargen; never suppress other starting feats.

issues.evidence: Class feature catalog contains 53 definitions (40 ACTIVE/STUB, 8 ACTIVE/CHOICE_GRANT, 3 PASSIVE/RULE, 2 INFO_ONLY/INFO); level-up manifest materializes typed class_feature and scaling_feature as locked feat items; that materialization alone does not prove mechanical activation.
issues.expected: One owner per class feature mechanic with runtime tests for scaling, duration, usage, prerequisites.
